title: S8 'can I travel with the other speakers?' — LIVE NL intake + deterministic TRANSPORT_CONCENTRATION rejection

boundaries.note: natural-language cross-traveller association request interpreted by LIVE Model Studio into the frozen ChangeRequest schema (quoted peer traveller ids), zod-validated
declared for run-mode coverage only: this policy-rejection scenario gathers no provider evidence, so the flight adapter is never called

steps.description: Traveller asks in natural language to travel with the other speakers, quoting the peer traveller ids; deterministic TRANSPORT_CONCENTRATION policy assesses the grouping

body.text: Can I travel with the other speakers on the same flight? My peers trv-evt-ait-2026-ait-draft-10 and trv-evt-ait-2026-ait-draft-11 are also speaking at the summit.

assert.description: the NL association request is accepted
the request came from interpretation, not a pre-structured target
the grouping desire maps to a transport schedule change
a recovery case opens for the request

assert.expected: travel association requested with 2 peer traveller(s): trv-evt-ait-2026-ait-draft-10, trv-evt-ait-2026-ait-draft-11
assert.description: peer travellers are identified from the quoted ids

assert.expected: transport concentration policy: requested association groups 3 critical traveller(s), exceeding the limit of 2; the grouping is NOT permitted
assert.description: deterministic TRANSPORT_CONCENTRATION policy rejects the grouping — no S8-specific engine branches
the violation is recorded as an alternative-required uncertainty
a policy violation is HIGH severity
the rejection names the required next step instead of silently dropping the desire

steps.description: Observe opened recovery case still open for alternative planning

assert.description: the case remains open for alternative planning
the case is a recovery case on the subject trip
